_auth_mode: codex-oauth-subscription (via proxy/codex_bridge, not a metered API key)
_model_note: Use openai/<model> (NOT openai/responses/<model>): the SDK routes gpt-5* via the native Responses path; the responses/ segment would leak into the body model id, break cost lookup, and nest output dirs. Only gpt-5.6-sol is accepted by the ChatGPT-account Codex backend (verified 2026-08-10).
_ec2_note: On Linux/EC2 change base_url host to 172.17.0.1:8766 (host.docker.internal is macOS Docker Desktop only).
